params.amount: The number of tokens to mint.
params.to: The recipient address of the newly minted tokens.

mint(address,uint256).notice: Mints new tokens to a specified address. Creates `amount` new tokens and assigns them to the `to` address, increasing the total supply. This function can only be called by an entity with the appropriate minting privileges
